goal: Stop falsely reporting transactions as missing when disk reads fail or indexes are corrupt
Alert node operators and RPC clients to disk I/O errors instead of silently masking them
Correctly distinguish pruned or un-downloaded blocks from missing transactions
agreement: Concept approval for separating missing transactions from internal I/O errors (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Objection resolved: preserved 'Block not available' error message for pruned blocks (yuvicc)
Clarified that test harness datadir cleanup makes try-finally blocks unnecessary (musaHaruna)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because masking disk I/O failures and index corruption hides system damage from node operators
P2 because treating unreadable index records as missing transactions produces silent false negatives

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC callers currently receive misleading not-found errors during read failures and pruning
P2 because returning explicit errors prevents clients from assuming confirmed transactions do not exist
